preprocessed_steps.title: Otsu Lesion Segmentation
preprocessed_steps.description: Segmented the lesion out of general skin surface utilizing Otsu thresholding and HSV channels.

preprocessed_steps.title: Image Resizing (224x224)
preprocessed_steps.description: Resized the input image to a standard 224x224 resolution for uniform neural network processing.

preprocessed_steps.title: Dull Razor Hair Removal
preprocessed_steps.description: Applied Dull Razor blackhat morphologic filter to construct hair masks and Telea inpainting to smooth hair tracks.

preprocessed_steps.title: Gaussian Noise Blur
preprocessed_steps.description: Utilized Gaussian filtering with a 5x5 kernel to clear out high-frequency noise and pixel distortions.

preprocessed_steps.title: Median Filter Denoise
preprocessed_steps.description: Processed with 5px Median Blur to filter salt-and-pepper artifacts while preserving structural bounds.

preprocessed_steps.title: Bilateral Edge Preservation
preprocessed_steps.description: Employed Bilateral Filtering to achieve smoothing of textures without degrading edge definitions.

preprocessed_steps.title: CLAHE Histogram Eq
preprocessed_steps.description: Applied Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) to fix lighting imbalances.

preprocessed_steps.title: Contrast Tuning
preprocessed_steps.description: Refined scale brightness metrics manually to highlight subtle color transitions in skin tissue.

preprocessed_steps.title: Color Normalization
preprocessed_steps.description: Scaled pixel channel intensity values uniformly between 0-255 boundary limits.

preprocessed_steps.title: Canny Edge Outline
preprocessed_steps.description: Executed Canny Edge Detection to define physical structures and outer contours of the skin lesion.
